title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent works with GitHub, Asana and Jira through MCP servers
summary: Hold: the statement that Channel Agent is automatically created by default omits Microsoft's education-tenant exception, where auto-creation is off by default. The roadmap facts, paused rollout, admin enablement and listed app controls are supported; the briefing also needs to acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance about DLP.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Channel Agent integration with selected third-party MCP servers, including GitHub, Asana and Atlassian (Jira).
claims.quote: Agent-MCP Orchestration in Teams enables Channel agent to work with select third-party MCP servers, such as GitHub, Asana and  Atlassian (JIRA).

claims.claim: Teams can attach a dedicated Channel Agent to a channel.
claims.quote: Now, each channel can have a dedicated agent that draws on its conversations and meetings to act as a domain expert for the team.

claims.claim: When asked a question, Channel Agent can collaborate with tools to gather information.
claims.quote: When a user asks Channel Agent a question, the agent can collaborate with other tools to gather information or complete tasks

claims.claim: The Channel Agent Learn page does not describe MCP orchestration.

claims.claim: Channel Agent itself is allowed by default.

claims.claim: By default a Channel Agent is automatically added to any new channel an eligible user creates.
claims.quote: Auto-creation will be default Off for EDU tenants. If you would like to have auto-creation, follow the steps above and toggle auto-creation from Off to On.
claims.fix: Add immediately after the automatic-creation statement: 'For EDU tenants, however, auto-creation is off by default.' The existing statement omits an exception that changes the default an education administrator should expect.

claims.claim: Channel Agent checks the requesting user's file permissions and does not use inaccessible files.

claims.claim: Channel Agent does not use files whose sensitivity labels prevent extraction.

claims.claim: The setup page says Channel Agent does not use files with DLP policies that prevent AI use.
claims.quote: It won't use ... files with DLP policies that prevent AI-usage.
claims.fix: Add after this statement: 'Microsoft's Purview considerations page gives different guidance: it says administrators cannot prevent Channel Agent from summarising labelled files identified by a Microsoft Purview Data Loss Protection policy.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-m365-copilot-considerations#information-protection-considerations-for-channel-agent-in-teams. Its text says: 'You can't prevent Channel Agent from summarizing labeled files that are identified by a Microsoft Purview Data Loss Protection policy.'

claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" pricing meter cap Microsoft 365 Copilot license; "Channel Agent" "MCP" GitHub Asana Jira licenses billing. Read setup page and licence options; meter results describe Copilot Studio, Copilot Chat or SharePoint agents, not this integration.

claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" pricing meter cap Microsoft 365 Copilot license; "Channel Agent" "MCP" GitHub Asana Jira licenses billing. Read setup and licence options pages and billing search excerpts; no price for this integration.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described which Channel Agent content is sent to these third-party MCP servers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" "MCP" authentication consent approval data third party; "Channel Agent" third party MCP DLP audit sensitivity labels data sent. Read setup and Purview pages; results document other MCP clients, not this data transfer.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the identity used by Channel Agent to access these third-party MCP servers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" "MCP" authentication consent approval data third party. Read setup and Purview pages and search excerpts; authentication results concern Databricks, Copilot Studio or other agents, not Channel Agent orchestration.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described how a user authorises the Channel Agent third-party connection.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" "MCP" authentication consent approval data third party. Read setup page, MC1182703 and authentication search excerpts; no authorisation procedure for this feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the specific third-party actions available through this integration.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" "orchestration"; "Channel Agent" "MCP" authentication consent approval data third party. Read roadmap, MC1182703 and setup page; no operation list for Channel Agent third-party tools.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described whether a user must approve each third-party action.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether Channel Agent file permission, label and DLP checks govern content sent to these third-party MCP servers.
claims.quote: Searched: "Channel Agent" third party MCP DLP audit sensitivity labels data sent. Read setup and ai-teams-channel-agent in full and ai-m365-copilot-considerations excerpts; they describe file access and Teams messages, not this outbound MCP transfer.
